question: Should OpenClaw permanently add capability-gated append to the built-in `write` tool and the public `SandboxFsBridge` contract?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and addresses a real data-loss mode, but correctness alone cannot approve new model-facing and plugin-facing API commitments.

options.title: Sponsor native append
options.body: Approve the opt-in capability-gated API, refresh it onto current main, and land after focused Docker, tool-schema, and Plugin SDK validation remains green.

options.title: Choose another primitive
options.body: Reject this API shape and define a different concurrency-safe file operation before closing or replacing this PR.

recommendation.title: Sponsor native append
recommendation.body: Approve the opt-in capability-gated API, refresh it onto current main, and land after focused Docker, tool-schema, and Plugin SDK validation remains green.
